description: O-config-copy: bootstrap three nodes, elect node 1, commit remove-3 through implicit or explicit joint consensus, then read live AutoLeave and RawNode.Status synchronously after ApplyConfChange and before Advance. Compare the exported field to that observed source; direct Clone and live-after observations diagnose path and side effects.

harness.description: Actual public RawNode producer/consumer sequence with read-only live-state observation. Two independent cases use implicit true and explicit false modes.
semantic_changes: No target edits, direct protocol-state mutation or fabricated messages.
MemoryStorage substitutes persistence in a no-crash history; Ready entries and HardState are stored before message delivery.
Public methods are serialized; private tracker.AutoLeave is read solely to observe the input to Status. No protocol event occurs between source read and result.

legality.derivation: Fresh empty storage is bootstrapped via the public API, election uses actual messages, and the application observes a committed EntryConfChangeV2 and calls ApplyConfChange. All entries are persisted before transport and applied before Advance. The thread-unsafe RawNode has one serialized caller. Status is an ordinary read-only query between application and acknowledgment; automatic exit cannot run concurrently. Expected rejection of responses from removed peers is logged.
legality.applicability: No crash, loss, snapshot or compaction; implicit and explicit joint transitions are supported public choices.

grounding.derivation: RawNode.Status reports current group state and invokes Config.Clone, whose contract is to return a copy. Compare its AutoLeave against the live source field read immediately before the serialized call. The producer is actual application of the committed configuration entry, not a crafted Config. False explicit-mode control is retained; true implicit mode is not an applicability filter.
grounding.applicability: Same node and committed entry in a serialized legal history, before advancing the Ready containing that entry.
alternatives: Map membership may be copied correctly and live AutoLeave may remain true despite an incorrect exported field; downstream protocol corruption is not asserted.

observable_properties.description: The AutoLeave scalar in the returned configuration equals the corresponding live source scalar at the serialized Status call.

uncertainties: This checks scalar value preservation only; it does not assert a caller consumes the incorrect status for protocol decisions or that live state is corrupted.
